newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals end mixed after hitting new low.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals end mixed after hitting new low.

text.p: New York precious metals futures ened mixed Wednesday, but not before new contract lows were seen across most of the complex.

"With central bank sales confirmed this week, more Australian producer hedging noted in the past few days, and North American producer hedging likely above $358 an ounce, things still look problematic for gold," Mitsui USA bullion dealer, Greg Drury, said.
"We're seeing some physical demand in Southeast Asia but with US inflation low and returns on paper assets good there is no investor interest," he said.
